text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the autumn Tenno Sho draws closer, signs of fatigue begin to appear.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gahhhh… It's like my brain and my legs are all stuck…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?! We've only one run lap.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ughhh… I dunno. It's like the everyday drain is catching up with me. Like I've got the chills or something.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uhhh… Crash!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We bring Daitaku Helios to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: With that training routine, it was only a matter of time until something like this happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Why?! I'm doing the same routine. How come she's the only one passed out?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You may share the same ambitions, but you do not share the same constitution. Daitaku Helios is—
choice_data_list: Ah. It's because she's a miler.
Ah. It's because she's a miler.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Precisely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios is best at miles and sprints. Her performance tops out at around 2,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If she has been doing medium-distance training with you ever since the Takarazuka Kinen, this was only to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way… She didn't complain even once when we were running together over the summer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So how come…
choice_data_list: She must've been holding it in.
She must've been holding it in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she was in pain, she was doing it for her friend. That's the kind of person Daitaku Helios is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It is… possible she was holding it in. But if I were to hazard a guess…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, actually… I just totes forgot about it. ♪ Whoopsie! ☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What are you doing up?! You should be resting! And what do you mean you forgot?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Y'know how when you get super into something and your brain just kinda shuts down?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I was so happy running with you that my mind just went blank! ☆ I wasn't even thinking about the distances we were running. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, Helios…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It wasn't exactly self-sacrifice, but it does seem Daitaku Helios was pushing herself for the sake of their friendship.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Helios? I was thinking, maybe I should run in the autumn Tenno Sho by myself…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna put you through any more trouble. So…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You wanna run by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So that's how it is, huh? This is it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios stares up at the ceiling and opens her mouth…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, I don't think so. That's totally outta the question.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What? Why?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No offense, but I don't think you can really go off all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's the freakin' Tenno Sho. Everyone there's gonna bring it, and the pressure's gonna be unreal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously, Palmster… There's no way you're ready to party solo yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: W-well…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Even if you said you could, there's no way I'd believe you. After all…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I know you, Palmster. ♪ Better than you know yourself. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios sees straight through her. Because she treasures their friendship as much as she does, she knows Mejiro Palmer better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer still doesn't have the peace of mind necessary to enjoy running in the autumn Tenno Sho by herself…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Plus! All this tough as nails training I've been doing with you has made me super strong. ★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Plus plus, there's something I'm really looking forward to seeing when we come out the other side of this!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Once we take first and second place together, I wanna see you standing proud and yelling "Eat your hearts out!" to everyone. ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No doubt it's gonna hit way different seeing that from right next to you. ☆ There's no way I'm giving up that seat. ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: After all, you're my number one bestie! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after passing out, it seems Daitaku Helios's feelings are resolute as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But will her body be able to hold out till the end? I give Ikuno Dictus an inquiring look.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If I were a doctor, I would not recommend that she continue. However… I am not a doctor.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I think it is important to take an individual's feelings into account. That is how I like to manage things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Like." There's the keyword we've been chasing this entire time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What Mejiro Palmer likes. What Daitaku Helios likes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They need to shake off their obligations, remove the walls around their hearts, and chase after the desires that are in danger of being buried. Right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case…
choice_data_list: Do your best in the autumn Tenno Sho, Helios.
Do your best in the autumn Tenno Sho, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Yasss, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's prioritize what you two would like to do.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Awww yeah! ☆ You totally get it! Trainer got the vibes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Now, listen up, Palmer! I'm gonna run with you until you can have just as much fun running all by yourself! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And I won't stop till you can. ★ Cross my heart!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks, sis. I'm counting on you. If you're there with me, I know I got this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's slay the autumn Tenno Sho! We've got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so they maintain their balance atop the tightrope of their friendship. The rope they're walking is thin… but extraordinarily strong.
